ladder: This is WP-6 of the ACTIVE recovery lane: WP-1 closed RFC-049, WP-2 reconstructed campaign state, WP-3 audited the 24 cells, WP-4/5 reported. WP-6 turns the cost plane from a gate into a searched surface: which (venue, execution mode, size, liquidity) lines any cell can clear, and at which horizon.

execution_direction.question: is post-only execution cheaper than market execution?
execution_direction.note: measured, not assumed. Post-only is dearer wherever the maker fee is non-zero, because the model inflates an unfilled leg's fee by 1/fill_probability; it is cheaper only where the maker fee really is 0 (or the taker fee dominates).

spot_funding_guard.probe: call a spot scenario with a non-zero funding rate
spot_funding_guard.note: the model applies carry whenever a rate is supplied, whatever the product. The guard therefore lives in the caller: this explorer only ever passes a funding rate to perpetual scenarios.

model_horizon.question: does the all-in round trip depend on holding time?
model_horizon.note: at a zero funding rate the model's cost has no horizon term: fees, spread, slippage and impact are per-execution quantities. Horizon enters only through funding carry on perpetuals, measured separately below.

funding_horizon.question: how does holding time enter the barrier on a perpetual?
funding_horizon.note: carry is linear in both rate and horizon: rate x horizons / intervals_per_day. The analytic column is computed here from the measured interval length and must equal the model's own carry component.

market_horizon.question: how long does the market itself need to move the cost line?
market_horizon.source_definition: bars_to_X = median bars for a move equal to X bps
market_horizon.note: round trips convert to a *market* horizon through these medians. If the median move at a timeframe already exceeds the line, the market's amplitude is not the binding constraint; capture efficiency is.

frequency.question: what does the 3-operations-per-day objective cost per year?
frequency.note: cost-only arithmetic: gross edge must exceed these figures before any net profit exists. No strategy in the repository is claimed to sustain them.
